FEAT-6-S106.title: Consent Schema and Pydantic Contract Definition
FEAT-6-S106.description: Define and standardize consent data structures using Pydantic models, including tier definitions, consent flags, audit fields, and request/response contracts for all services consuming consent decisions.

FEAT-6-S107.title: Consent API Exposure via Tool Router
FEAT-6-S107.description: Expose consent workflow through the tool_router to allow the LLM agent to trigger consent checks, tier upgrades, and user prompts. Ensure strict validation and allowlist enforcement per GOV-004.

FEAT-6-S108.title: Consent Workflow Unit and Integration Tests
FEAT-6-S108.description: Implement unit and integration tests covering consent tier classification, de-identification enforcement, lead capture gating, and unknown question handling. Validate correct behavior across Tier 1 and Tier 2 scenarios.

FEAT-6-S109.title: End-to-End Consent Flow Integration in Main Application
FEAT-6-S109.description: Integrate consent workflow into main FastAPI entrypoint, ensuring all inbound chat requests pass through consent evaluation before invoking domain services. Enforce consistent propagation of consent decisions across the system.
